$Comment: The sawmill's trophy-wielder find table (SawmillFinds' fourth tier, reachable only with the Sawmiller's Hatchet or a better modded tool in hand): a winning roll ALWAYS pays - 90 percent for 3 to 5 life essence, 10 percent for 1 to 2 CONCENTRATED life essence. No empty entry: the tool that took a 1 in 2500 chase to earn never comes up dry on a find. The per-cycle cadence lives on the referencing Roll's own 15 percent chance. A find is deliberately a DIFFERENT item from the cycle's own planks - extra planks are the station's Grants.OutputItems concern, never a drop table's.
